_meta.note: Named poses. Each key may be a joint TYPE (e.g. 'hip_pitch' -> both legs, 'elbow_pitch' -> both arms) or a full joint_name (e.g. 'left_hip_pitch' -> that joint only, overrides the type). Any configured joint NOT named in a pose is SKIPPED (left uncommanded). Joints/types in 'always_skip' are skipped in every pose. knee 0deg is a hardstop -- keep it a few degrees positive. ARM angles are URDF frame: elbow 0=straight/+90=bent, shoulder_roll -15=hanging/+75=out to the side.

standing._comment: Tune for your robot; free-standing balance still needs the IMU/policy.

arm_rest._comment: Arm hanging at the side, elbow just off straight. Low torque everywhere.

arm_tpose._comment: The calibration reference pose, a few degrees inside the +75 limit.

arm_bent._comment: Hanging upper arm, forearm up. Shows the elbow clearly; near-zero shoulder load.

arm_forward._comment: Reaching forward with a bent elbow. Elbow bend keeps the shoulder torque down.
